stem: One cultivar is rooting several days slower than another but remains healthy. What is the best interpretation?
choices: Every cultivar must root on the same schedule
The slower lot should be discarded immediately
Record cultivar-specific rooting timing and continue evaluating against supplied acceptance criteria
Increase light intensity until rooting matches the other cultivar
rationale: Genotype can influence rooting speed, so consistent records are more useful than forcing all cultivars onto one calendar.
